title: Effect Schema.mutable fixed for encoded arrays; pipe order matters
claim: Effect #7519 (merged 2026-08-28T17:10Z, after the 2026-08-28 packet cut) fixes Schema.mutable with encoded arrays (closes #7517). Intended pipe order is Schema.Array(...).pipe(Schema.mutable, Schema.withDecodingDefaultType(...)); placing mutable after withDecodingDefaultType errors at runtime and mis-infers types. Still no effect@4.0.0-rc.113; SchemaBinary overnight fixes from 08-28 remain unreleased. Relevant to beep schema-first kits that mutate array fields then default them.
excerpt: Placing Schema.mutable after Schema.withDecodingDefaultType in a schema pipe causes runtime errors when decoding to the default and does not correctly infer a mutable decoded type. The confirmed intended usage is Schema.Array(...).pipe(Schema.mutable, Schema.withDecodingDefaultType(...)); any later placement of Schema.mutable should be rejected, ideally with a compile-time error.
suggested_capture: bun run beep research capture https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/pull/7519 --tags effect,effect-v4,schema,mutable

title: RedEvoAgent: red-team skill evolution with a validation ratchet
claim: RedEvoAgent (arXiv 2608.27439, 2026-08-27) is a black-box red-teaming agent that distills cross-case attack trajectories into a concise attack skill, evolves it via tool-effectiveness profiling and Deciding-Tool Attribution, and keeps only updates that improve a validation ratchet. Sits next to Daydreaming (skill steal) and WikiSkill (skill evolve): skills evolve on both attacker and defender sides without weight updates.
